gbm_population_evidence.quote: The subject has been newly diagnosed with glioblastoma (GB) based on preoperative neuroimaging

candidate_evidence.quote: The Elekta Xoft® Axxent® Electronic Brachytherapy (eBx®) System is a device that delivers high-dose-rate radiation.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Fifteen patients (male and female) with newly diagnosed glioblastoma who meet the inclusion/exclusion criteria

role_evidence.quote: Daily oral temozolomide (75 mg/m²) during EBRT.

coder_notes: The only registered intervention is resection plus intraoperative electronic brachytherapy (device/radiotherapy, labelled Biological). Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but the protocol text says every patient receives Stupp chemoradiation, so it is listed as soc_backbone. No candidate, so excluded at S6.
